responsibility: Declares the Rust metadata export interface and wire-format constants used by the front end to publish a crate’s public API. It defines the magic header and delimiter for exported metadata, the ExportContext accumulator that maps HIR items back to AST form and buffers serialized interface text, and the PublicInterface driver that decides crate-public visibility, gathers exportable items from a HIR crate, and writes the resulting metadata either into an object file or a standalone .rox file.
same_name_distinction: Provides the declarations and shared format definitions for metadata export, including the magic header, size delimiter, ExportContext, and PublicInterface API. Unlike the .cc peer, it does not perform HIR walking or write metadata; it defines the exporter’s types and entry points used by other files.
